layer 14 · definition · cluster Matrices and Determinants (`algebra.matrix`) · Abstract Algebra

## Statement · **draft**
Let $R \in M_{m \times n}(K)$. If

- every zero row lies below every nonzero row;
- in each nonzero row, the column of the first nonzero entry (called a **pivot**) lies strictly to the right of the pivot of the row above,

then $R$ is in **row echelon form**. If moreover every pivot equals $1$ and every other entry in a pivot column is $0$, then $R$ is in **reduced row echelon form** (RREF).
